newsitem.title: USA: Odwalla reintroduces three juice blends.
newsitem.headline: Odwalla reintroduces three juice blends.

text.p: Odwalla Inc said it was reintroducing to the market three juice blends that have been reformulated without apple juice.

Odwalla said it was bringing back to the market Strawberry "C" Monster, Serious Ginseng and Mo'Beta, blends that did not have the juice containing microbes identified in an outbreak of food poisoning.
The juice blends would begin appearing on store shelves in seven U.S. states and the Canadian province of British Columbia by November 8, it said.
Odwalla recalled 13 products last week after an outbreak of a potentially fatal strain of the E.coli bacteria linked to its apple juice.

"Our top priority is to provide our customers with only the safest, most wholesome products," it said. "Until we are assured of a completely safe and reliable method of producing apple juice, we will not include it in our juices."
